title: AI Research Scientist Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: AI Research Scientist.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Novel Architecture Design: Deep theoretical grasp of Transformer attention mechanisms, diffusion models, reinforcement learning (RLHF/DPO), and state-space models (Mamba).
2. Large-Scale Training Dynamics: Distributed training paradigms (Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, ZeRO, FSDP), loss stability, gradient checkpointing, and GPU cluster optimization.
3. Research Methodology: Hypothesis formulation, empirical validation, rigorous ablation studies, and mathematical proofs.
4. Research to Production Transfer: Efficient model architectures, quantization, distillation, and frontier safety alignment.
